_about: Peter Martyr Vermigli (1499-1562), Florentine Reformer, Regius Professor at Oxford under Edward VI, later at Strasbourg and Zurich: The Common Places, translated and partly gathered by Anthonie Marten (London, 1583); Most Learned and Fruitfull Commentaries upon the Epistle of S. Paul to the Romanes (London, 1568); and Most Fruitfull and Learned Comentaries upon the Booke of Judges (London, 1564). Elizabethan and Stuart English translations, as Early English Books Online scans on the Internet Archive; raw OCR of 16th- and 17th-century type (blackletter in places), poor in places. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
